reason: I'd grab the 50,000đ free credit and poke at it, but I'm not moving my balance off OpenRouter to a brand-new company I've never heard of. I already got burned once by a tool that shut down with my money in it.
objection: A new one-person company could disappear with my prepaid balance, and a 30-day refund window doesn't help if they're gone in month three.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it run reliably for a few months with other devs I know using it, plus a refund on unused credit any time, not just in the first 30 days.
